text: {"lessons":["I should avoid reacting to one month’s movement: my account has risen and fallen substantially, and no single move reliably establishes a lasting trend.","I should use consistent, goal-based rules for buying and selling; taking profits or cutting losses based only on whether a position is up or down can lead to arbitrary trades.","I should continue investing with a long-term view while keeping cash and diversifying, since reaching my apartment goal will take time and short-term account values can be volatile."]}
